chunks.title: RAGForge — Multi-Tenant Vector Retrieval System
chunks.text: RAGForge is a multi-tenant document Q&A system built by Ansh Arora. It parses PDF, DOCX, and TXT documents, chunks text into ~500-word sliding windows with 50-word overlap, generates 768-dimensional Gemini embeddings, and performs pgvector HNSW cosine similarity recall. The system delivers grounded multilingual cited answers in English and Hindi. Measured vector recall latency is under 60 ms across 10,000 embedded document chunks in PostgreSQL. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Gemini API, Tailwind CSS.

chunks.title: RAGForge — Architecture Decisions & Trade-Offs
chunks.text: In RAGForge, fixed-size chunking initially caused sentence truncations across chunk boundary points. Ansh Arora solved this by implementing sliding token-aware context windows preserving paragraph sentence boundaries. Vector embeddings are isolated per tenant using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies. Candidate re-scoring is planned next using cross-encoder reranking.

chunks.title: NSE Momentum & Breadth Scanner
chunks.text: The NSE Momentum & Breadth Scanner is a real-time market breadth analytics engine. It ingests high-frequency binary WebSocket ticks via Angel One SmartAPI, decodes raw packet structures, computes live advance/decline breadth ratios, and fans out updates over Server-Sent Events (SSE) to a React dashboard. Pipeline stages: AUTH (42ms), WEBSOCKET (12ms), DECODE (4ms), ANALYTICS (8ms), and BROADCAST (14ms). Stack: React 19, Node.js, Express, Angel One SmartAPI, Server-Sent Events, Tailwind CSS, node:test.

chunks.title: NSE Scanner — Session Engine & Zero Bias
chunks.text: Handling erratic price spikes during Indian market (IST) pre-open required building a dedicated session engine checking against NSE holidays and serving the last valid close without look-ahead bias. Automated node:test test suites provide 100% deterministic session testing verifying that no prices are fabricated. Future milestone: tick-by-tick order-flow volume absorption delta histograms.

chunks.title: GridGuard AI — Smart-Meter Telemetry with Explainable Anomaly Flags
chunks.text: GridGuard AI streams 50Hz simulated smart-meter telemetry over WebSockets into an XGBoost anomaly detection model, explains flagged readings with SHAP feature importance attributions (voltage sag, current surge, frequency drop), and visualizes substation distribution topology using React Flow. Ansh Arora was a Finalist at Summer of Code Fest 2.0 (GSOC Innovators Club, VIT Bhopal) with this project. Measured hop-to-hop telemetry latency is under 120 ms. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, XGBoost, SHAP, React Flow, Docker.

chunks.title: GridGuard AI — Circular Buffer Memory Management
chunks.text: Early iterations of GridGuard AI suffered memory pressure when buffering thousands of high-frequency telemetry points. Ansh resolved this by migrating time-series aggregation logic into fixed-size circular memory buffers. Next architectural phase: integrating synthetic load forecasting using temporal fusion transformers.

chunks.title: Delta Exchange Options Risk-Reward Engine
chunks.text: A Chrome MV3 extension HUD powered by a FastAPI backend consuming live Delta Exchange WebSocket order-flow data on 5-minute Bitcoin (BTC) charts. It computes real-time Black-Scholes Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega) and dynamic risk-reward boundaries for at-the-money options. Crucially, it issues a definitive NO TRADE flag whenever setup strength or volatility spread fails risk gates. Stack: Python, FastAPI, WebSockets, Chrome Extensions MV3, JavaScript.

chunks.title: CI/CD AI Sandbox Pipeline
chunks.text: The CI/CD AI Pipeline is an automated failure trace extractor and isolated patch verification sandbox. A webhook ingests failing GitHub Actions logs, extracts relevant error stack slices to reduce prompt tokens by 78%, asks an LLM for a candidate patch, and runs the fix in an isolated Docker container before creating a pull request. Stack: GitHub Actions, Node.js, Express, Docker, PostgreSQL, Gemini API.

chunks.title: NIFTY SMART LEAD (Pine Script v5 Intraday Indicator)
chunks.text: An intraday indicator designed by Ansh Arora in Pine Script v5 for TradingView. It combines VWAP bands, order-flow delta, volume acceleration, cooldown timers, trend-EMA filters, and a custom 48-period tuned RSI to eliminate false breakouts during active market sessions.

chunks.title: RCA Copilot — Root-Cause Analysis Synthesis
chunks.text: RCA Copilot synthesizes root-cause documentation from raw distributed incident logs. It executes a four-stage pipeline: pattern detection, timeline reconstruction, blast-radius estimation, and evidence scoring over unstructured logs. Live deployment at rca-ai.vercel.app. Stack: Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, TypeScript.
